value.name: Dicky returns to the gym
value.description: Dicky comes back into the gym just as Micky is about to train with O'Keefe.
evidence: Dicky walks back into the gym as Micky is about to work out with O'Keefe.

value.name: Alice asks what happened
value.description: Alice immediately asks Dicky what happened when he returns.

value.name: Dicky says Micky refused to work with him
value.description: Dicky explains that Micky said he cannot work with him.
evidence: DICKY He says I can't work with him.

value.name: Dicky protests being excluded
value.description: Dicky insists it is wrong and claims Micky would not have beaten Sanchez without him.
evidence: He never woulda won Sanchez without me!

value.name: O'Keefe challenges Dicky's insult
value.description: O'Keefe angrily objects when Dicky insults his mother.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE That's fuckin' bullshit! Take that back!
DICKY Don't talk to my mother my mother like that.

value.name: O'Keefe and Charlene demand Dicky leave
value.description: O'Keefe says they have to go if training is going to continue, and Charlene backs him up.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE They gotta go. If we're gonna train.
CHARLENE They have to go, Micky.

value.name: Alice presses Micky to answer
value.description: Alice urges everyone to ask Micky directly whether he would have won Sanchez without Dicky.
evidence: ALICE Why don't you ask Micky if he woulda won Sanchez without Dicky? Ask him.

value.name: Micky admits Dicky helped him win
value.description: After a tense pause, Micky says he would not have won Sanchez without Dicky.
evidence: MICKY I wouldn'ta won Sanchez without Dicky.

value.name: Charlene rebukes Micky's loyalty
value.description: Charlene criticizes Micky for saying that to O'Keefe, and Micky explains he changed tactics using what he learned from Dicky.
evidence: CHARLENE How can you say that to O'Keefe?
MICKY Because it's true. I went in with our plan and it wasn't working, I switched to what I learned with Dicky.

value.name: Micky softens toward O'Keefe
value.description: Micky tells O'Keefe he would not have won without him either, trying to balance his loyalty.
evidence: MICKY (CONT'D) I wouldn'ta won it without you, either, O'Keefe, you know that.

value.name: Charlene and Alice argue over credit
value.description: Charlene claims Micky's focus and confidence came from the family and O'Keefe, while Alice insists Dicky saved him and Charlene snaps back that they all saved him.
evidence: CHARLENE You got the focus and confidence from O'Keefe and Sal and your father and me!
ALICE You were lucky to win that fight, Dicky saved him!
CHARLENE We saved him! Dickya junkbag!
